sloka: क्व च यक्षार्जवं युद्धं क्व च मायाबलाश्रयम् ।रक्षसां पुरुषव्याघ्र तेन ते ऽभ्यधिका युधि ।। ७.१५.९ ॥
transliteration: kva ca yakṣārjavaṁ yuddhaṁ kva ca māyābalāśrayam ।rakṣasāṁ puruṣavyāghra tena te 'bhyadhikā yudhi ।। 7.15.9 ॥

translations.english: O tiger among men, how can the straightforward battle of the Yakshas compare with the Rakshasas' reliance on magical power, which is why the Rakshasas are superior in war.
